observation.text: Three assets shaped the quarter. One Financial Plaza (Chicago office) was written down on lower submarket comparables and a near-term lease expiry. Bayfront Apartments (San Diego) was held roughly flat as concessions offset rent growth. Prairie Logistics (Kansas City) contributed positively, partially offsetting the office drag. Leverage was conservative at ~28% LTV.
